source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Engine Fuel - Air Cleaners, p.6M-12

procedures.title: Polyurethane air cleaner element: clean
steps: Squeeze excess oil or solvent out; never shake, swing or wring the element, which can tear it.
Fit the element on its screen support (see figure 4A in the manual).
Set the air cleaner body back on the carburetor air horns with new gaskets.
Put the element in the air cleaner with its lower lip seated correctly and no folds or creases that would spoil the seal; check the upper lip is seated when fitting the cover.
